title: Generate the actual native translation descriptors from the five-field header and execute its complete same-owner pass
body:
## Exact scoped result
A 25-tape graph produces actual selected translation descriptors from five Gamma fields and performs complete post-matrix reversal with original-owner return. Independent source/address/census checks passed. The preceding linear matrix must be executed separately. Credits #7000 and #6992.

## Verification and limitations
Canonical base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. Mathematical proof, reproduction commands, independent or separate checks and negative controls are in the package. No new complete kappa: the selected bound remains conditional on all five foundational assumptions. This scoped enabling result is not an unconditional multiplication theorem.

## Credit and further detail
Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance; credit predecessor authors. Full proof and detailed PR description: https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/tree/1dbdaa414cfe4a4a0f015e88a04b52e146566786/research/native-translation-descriptor
